status: declared by the pull request that closes #409 before any score was computed; nothing here is tuned on a scored day; the choices below are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

target.label: an onset at the threshold: a day with SOFR - IORB above it and no such day on the five panel days before it (pressure.onsets, pressure.ONSET_QUIET_DAYS)
target.per_day: the horizon-h file holds P(day t+h is an onset), read at the decision instant of day t, h = 1 to 5; a training day with fewer than five panel days before it trains no pair
target.within_lead: 'an onset within lead h' is read through the five horizon files: an onset is flagged with lead h when its own horizon-h probability reached the cut-off, and 'at least h' when any horizon from h to 5 did (the judge's onset tier)
target.five_day_window: P(an onset or pressure day in the next five business days) is the judge's week-ahead tier: the maximum of the five per-day probabilities (pressure_judge.json tiers.week_ahead.combine)

features.note: base: the calendar, the reserve-scarcity state (#115) with reserves, and the weekly TGA change as the direct-model design reads them; funding: the daily TGA balance and its change (#377); optional_funding: the OFR tri-party and GCF overnight rates (#377), which enter with an observed indicator and a zero where not yet public, because the tri-party rate is real-time only from 2020-09-09 and the GCF rate is present on a minority of days; treasury_settlement leaves the inputs at h >= 2 (scheduled one business day ahead, so not public)

weighting.settings: ml.PRESSURE_RARE_EVENT_SETTINGS (#381): class_weight 'balanced' inside each fit's training rows, or the focal loss; unweighted for the one reference row
weighting.scarcity_state: reserve_scarcity_state (0 to 3) enters as a level, and reserves multiply every scheduled term, as in the settlement-timing track (#379)

recalibration: pressure.RECALIBRATION: Platt on the candidate's own earlier forecasts against the pressure-day outcome, out of fold, per threshold; this is the judged form because the onset probability alone sits on the onset-rate scale and the judge calibrates against pressure days; the raw fits are kept as an ablation
cutoffs: chosen by the judge's cutoff_rule from each refit's training window alone (pressure_judge.json); none is declared here
